name: ⚽ Soccer Legends [BETA]
desc:
Lace your boots, get your kit on, and prepare for the best soccer experience on Roblox here in Soccer Legends

Soccer Legends is a fast-paced simplistic Soccer / Football game where you can play in a competitive environment to become one of the best players within the game, Unlock new accessories and grind to get to the highest overall possible. 

💡 TIPS: 
🔘 Use shift lock for the best experience within the game, it helps you out with dribbling and shooting tremendously! 
🔘 Invite friends for an even more fun experience! 
🔘 Check out the VIP pass so that you can gain Gems and XP faster!

tuzen - Builder
